aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:669.title: Box Office Attendant - Royal Oak Music Theater
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:669.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! With offices on five continents, the company uses its global network of venues, portfolio of powerful sports and music brands, ticketing and content distribution platforms and its integrated entertainment districts to deliver the most creative and innovative live sports and entertainment experiences that inspire athletes, teams, artists and fans. Position Summary: The Box Office Attendant is responsible for communicating information regarding the location, event, seating options, price structures, and other details to help guests select the best event ticket option. The incumbent will process ticket orders and collects payments. Essential Functions: Accurately and efficiently processes orders for and collect payments from guests. Follow cash handling and inventory procedures to ensure security of assets and inventory. Greet customers with a positive and friendly demeanor. Assist guests by providing information, answering questions and processing requests. Resolve customer concerns by providing superior customer service, utilizing common practices for resolution and escalating to supervisor when needed. Provides up-selling opportunities to similar events in the genre by demonstrating a strong knowledge of upcoming events. Contributes to the team dynamic by assisting coworkers, maintaining the facilities’ cleanliness and helping to develop and maintain a positive work environment. Required Qualifications: A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency A minimum of 0-1 years of related work experience Excellent customer service skills Must be able to work independently and in a team setting Good communication skills to effectively communicate with customers and co-workers Basic Math skills Must be responsible and professional Effective decision-making skills Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment Available to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends Payscale: $10 - $15 Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits : Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification). AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:cc.title: CNC Machinist
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:cc.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel, located in Eunice, LA, is looking for experienced CNC Machinists to join our team. The CNC Machinist must be capable of operating machines in a steel plant. This individual must possess the ability to read a tape measure; must possess basic math aptitude. The CNC Machinist will safely operate CNC machinery (drill, saw, etc.). This individual will perform daily preventative maintenance on machines.
responsibilities: Operates CNC machines.
Measures dimensions of finished steel structures to ensure conformance to specifications, using precision measuring instruments, templates, and fixtures.
Mounts, installs, aligns, and secures tools, attachments, fixtures, and workpieces on machines, using hand tools and precision measuring instruments.
Listens to machines during operation to detect sounds such as those made by dull cutting tools or excessive vibration and adjust machines to compensate for problems.
Adjusts machine feed and speed, change cutting tools, or adjust machine controls.
Stops machines to remove finished workpieces or to change tooling, setup, or workpiece placement, according to required machining sequences.
Lifts workpieces to machines manually or with hoists or cranes.
Modifies cutting programs to account for problems encountered during operation and saves modified programs.
Inserts control instructions into machine control units to start operation.
qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Ability to read and interpret typed reports and schedules required.
Ability to interpret blueprints required.
Ability to read a tape measure required.
Certifications or prior experience using moving machinery, such as cranes, preferred.
Basic math aptitude required.
Must complete on-site training and demonstrate safe operation of machinery.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: About Pioneering Medicines: Pioneering Medicines, Flagship Pioneering’s in-house drug development unit, is dedicated to conceiving and developing a broad portfolio of life-changing treatments for patients built from Flagship’s innovative platforms. Harnessing the drug development expertise of its team together with the power of Flagship's multiple scientific platforms, Pioneering Medicines explores and identifies new product concepts which are then advanced jointly with Flagship’s bioplatform companies. Within Flagship’s Innovation Supply Chain partnerships, Pioneering Medicines works with external collaborators to apply its unique approach to partners’ R&D priorities. These partnerships are highly co-creative strategic alliances that accelerate therapeutic innovation by bringing together partners spanning the full spectrum of drug discovery, development, and production. Position Summary: Pioneering Medicines is seeking an innovative, motivated, and highly collaborative Scientist/Senior Scientist to join our Translational Sciences team. The position supports translational research and immunological activities aimed at bridging the gap between early research and clinical development. This role will be directly accountable on data delivery to support the deep characterization of novel and emerging drug candidates, and/or execution of biomarker assays to evaluate pharmacology of therapeutic molecules. The candidate will be supported by scientific leaders to develop experience and expertise in drug discovery and pharmacology. We are looking for adaptive and scientifically curious individuals who embrace our core values of putting people and patients first, in an environment that encourages growth and learning. This position is on-site in Cambridge, MA. Key Responsibilities: Deliver impactful datasets to inform the translational direction of drug discovery program(s) (e.g., pharmacodynamic biomarker discovery for disease/patient selection, inform human dose predictions, develop novel biomarker assays) Contribute to drug discovery programs supporting immunology and/or translational research goals and strategies. Collaborate on capability building to support immunology/translational needs and emerging program needs. Communicate research plans and data to colleagues with diverse scientific backgrounds. Contribute to other prioritized activities and initiatives within the drug discovery group, aligned with team needs and personal interests. Demonstrate an insatiable curiosity, strong work ethic, and the ability to work equally well in a team or independently. Required Qualifications Bachelor or Master of Science degree in biology, immunology, pharmacology or equivalent with 5+ years’ experience in a laboratory of academia or industry. Ph.D. in biology, immunology, pharmacology with 2+ years experience in industry. Must have experience with ex-vivo assay development in rodent, NHP and human tissues/plasma/whole blood Must have experience with in vitro T cell differentiation (e.g. Treg, Th17) Must have experience working using flow cytometry for phenotyping whole blood, primary T cell culture, etc. Experience working with sterile cell culture techniques for the growth and maintenance of cell lines and primary cells (e.g. peripheral blood mononuclear cells, organoids, explant cultures) Hands-on experience with isolating and manipulating primary cells to perform downstream analysis (e.g. MSD/ELISA, FACS, western blots, qPCR, histology, fluorescence microscopy) Can think on their feet and demonstrate sophisticated scientific thinking in their data analysis. Ability and interest to work across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities. Preferred Qualifications Preclinical research experience that supports early phase clinical studies or is directly related to the understanding of human disease/pharmacology. Experience with advanced cell biology techniques (e.g. organoid cultures, immune cell co-cultures) for use in pharmacology/translational

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3287d454-53f6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Revenue Enablement Manager based in United States. As Revenue Enablement Manager, you will serve as a strategic partner to New Business, Account Management, and Customer Success teams, helping translate business priorities into measurable revenue impact. You will own enablement programs, content, systems, and performance frameworks across the revenue lifecycle. Working closely with Product Marketing and Customer Education, you will ensure customer-facing teams are prepared for launches, pricing changes, competitive shifts, and evolving market priorities. You will build practical playbooks, learning programs, and resources that improve how teams win, expand, and retain customers. Data and AI will play a central role in helping you measure adoption, identify opportunities, and make enablement more effective. This is a high-visibility role for an experienced enablement professional who can influence across teams, operate independently, and connect enablement activity directly to business outcomes. Build and maintain enablement systems, programs, and content that strengthen Sales and Customer Success motions, including deal-stage playbooks, talk tracks, sales-stage content mapping, and expansion or upsell resources. Keep enablement materials aligned with evolving products, packaging, messaging, pricing, competitive dynamics, and business priorities. Partner with Product Marketing and Customer Education to coordinate readiness for product launches, messaging updates, pricing changes, and competitive developments while maintaining consistent messaging across revenue-facing channels. Design and deliver competitive positioning resources, battle cards, objection-handling frameworks, and learning experiences using both instructor-led and asynchronous formats and applying adult learning principles. Own the Enablement AI Hub and broader enablement technology stack, using AI to analyze data, generate insights, develop resources, improve efficiency, and explore new applications within revenue workflows. Establish a field-adherence framework that connects enablement programs and content to measurable revenue outcomes, including win rate, sales-cycle length, net revenue retention, expansion, time-to-value, and churn-risk escalations. Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting that demonstrate program adoption, field adherence, business impact, and enablement ROI over time. Lead a recurring enablement performance cadence with Sales and Marketing leadership, translating data into clear recommendations and ensuring agreed actions are tracked through completion. Facilitate enablement sessions for large and small groups, as well as individual coaching, helping customer-facing teams apply new knowledge and tools effectively. Collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders without formal authority, building alignment among Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and other teams. Manage multiple enablement initiatives simultaneously, maintaining clear priorities, milestones, communication plans, and measurable outcomes. Requirements 5+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, GTM Enablement, Product Marketing, or a closely related function within a B2B SaaS environment. Proven experience directly supporting New Business, Enterprise Sales, Account Management, and/or Customer Success teams and contributing to revenue growth. Strong ability to understand the needs and expectations of Sales and Customer Success leadership and translate them into practical programs, guidance, and resources. Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority and build alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and related teams. Strong business and product acumen, with the ability to translate positioning, pricing, competitive dynamics, and product changes

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3d5a7aa4-d23d-.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:3d5a7aa4-d23d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Poland. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Requirements: Cybersecurity and threat intelligence interest: Suitable for aspiring CTI analysts, cybersecurity students or graduates, SOC professionals seeking CTI exposure, career changers, intelligence or security professionals transitioning into cyber, self-taught practitioners, and professionals with relevant cybersecurity certifications. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions. Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization. Source evaluation: Ability to assess the reliability,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:dfe47914-4ea4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Systems Game Designer based in Canada. This is a senior individual contributor role at the intersection of systems design, storytelling, social play, and player creativity. You’ll shape the gameplay systems that allow players to build worlds, express themselves, interact with others, and create their own stories. Working closely with Product, Engineering, AI, and Art, you’ll take ideas from early concepts through prototyping, implementation, and iteration. Your work will span progression, economies, crafting, creative tools, social mechanics, and long-term engagement loops. You’ll combine strong systems thinking with an understanding of player motivation, autonomy, narrative, and emotional expression. As part of a lean, high-trust team, you’ll have substantial ownership and the opportunity to influence both the product and the way it is built. This is an opportunity to help define a new category of AI-powered, social, creative gaming while working on ambitious features with meaningful player impact. Design and evolve short-, medium-, and long-term gameplay loops, reward structures, progression systems, and core game mechanics. Create, prototype, and implement systems across creative tools, progression, social play, crafting, player-generated content, and game economies. Translate high-level product and gameplay goals into detailed specifications, wireframes, UX flows, prototypes, and playable concepts. Work closely with Product Managers and cross-functional partners to turn concepts into polished, intuitive, and expressive player experiences. Partner with Engineering, AI, and Art teams throughout development to ensure systems are technically feasible, engaging, and aligned with the overall product vision. Incorporate personality, narrative hooks, tone, and emotional expression into systems to encourage emergent storytelling. Design systems around player motivation, agency, autonomy, achievement, and long-term engagement, drawing on frameworks such as Self-Determination Theory (SDT/PENS). Analyze player behavior and feedback to identify opportunities for iteration, balance, and improvement. Help develop and refine game economies, progression structures, and reward systems that support sustainable player engagement. Explore how generative AI and emerging technologies can empower players and create new forms of gameplay and creative expression. Take ownership of features from initial concept through prototyping, implementation, launch, measurement, and ongoing evolution. Contribute hands-on to solving broader product and gameplay challenges in a fast-moving startup environment. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience designing features and systems for leading mobile free-to-play games. Strong systems design background, ideally within strategy, life simulation, sandbox, creativity, social, or similar game genres. Deep expertise in at least one major systems discipline, such as feature design, progression, game economy, crafting, or user-generated content systems. Demonstrated ability to translate high-level concepts into well-designed features that successfully ship, perform, and evolve. Strong understanding of player motivation, engagement, agency, and autonomy. Ability to think visually and communicate ideas effectively through wireframes, prototypes, flows, mockups, and other design artifacts. Strong collaboration skills and experience working directly with engineers, product managers, artists, and other multidisciplinary teams. AI-curious or AI-fluent, with genuine enthusiasm for exploring generative technologies and their potential to expand player creativity. Creative sensibility with an appreciation for storytelling, tone, mood, character, and emotional expression in addition to gameplay mechanics. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fc08f889-de46-.title: Population Health Coordinator - Medical Focus
jobgether-jobgether:lever:fc08f889-de46-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Population Health Coordinator - Medical Focus based in the United States. This role supports high-acuity and medically complex populations throughout critical stages of their care and recovery journey. You will combine population health management, care coordination, data analysis, and direct member engagement to improve outcomes. The position focuses on pregnant and postpartum members, recently hospitalized individuals, and members facing complex medical or substance-use-related needs. Working within a Collaborative Care Model, you will partner closely with medical providers, counselors, specialists, and care teams across multiple regions. You will help identify care gaps, monitor member progress, coordinate interventions, and contribute to quality improvement initiatives. The role also provides opportunities to support innovative pilot programs and improve how care is delivered to vulnerable populations. Success requires clinical expertise, adaptability, strong communication, and a genuine commitment to delivering compassionate, coordinated care. Maintain accurate member registries for specialized populations and care pathways, using data to track outcomes, assess progress, prioritize work, and support care-team decision-making. Facilitate regular registry reviews with counselors, medical providers, consulting specialists, and other interdisciplinary team members. Participate in caseload consultations and communicate treatment recommendations and care priorities to appropriate members of the care team. Analyze population-level data and care outcomes to identify opportunities for quality improvement and recommend initiatives that enhance care delivery. Perform and document internal and external care coordination activities for members with complex medical needs or challenging care scenarios. Support local care teams in applying the Collaborative Care Model and assist with training on registry reviews, asynchronous consultations, concise clinical presentations, and related workflows. Manage an assigned member caseload through telephone, SMS, and individual telemedicine interactions, providing screenings, structured assessments, brief interventions, and care coordination. Educate members about common physical health, mental health, and substance-use conditions, available treatment options, and strategies for navigating their care. Provide transitional care support to high-acuity members entering or progressing through recovery, including interdisciplinary meetings, orientation groups, care coordination, and individual support. Facilitate and document treatment-plan updates in collaboration with medical and clinical providers. Identify and escalate urgent or crisis situations to appropriate clinical or medical leadership and support follow-up and safety-planning activities. Support pilot projects by providing administrative, technical, analytical, and leadership assistance as delegated by medical, clinical, and operational leaders. For the Medical Focus, support medication management activities by monitoring adherence, side effects, and treatment effectiveness in accordance with provider direction. Help develop and deliver accessible, low-barrier, culturally appropriate educational materials covering addiction medicine, primary care, and other relevant medical topics. Review medical information and prepare documentation that enables medical colleagues to practice efficiently at the appropriate level of clinical expertise. Support medical-related care coordination and contribute across other population focus areas when needed to ensure comprehensive member support. Requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license, or, in Maine only, Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) who completes the required SAMHSA training for an X-DEA license. Bachelor's degree in Nursing is preferred. At least 5 years of direct pat

Our ability to provide good recommendations is central to achieving trust, engagement, and, most importantly, whether people can find who they’re looking for on Hinge.

We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. We're hiring our first Head of Talent to help us do it again: doubling the team over the next year without diluting the bar. You'll build the systems, pipeline, and performance culture that let us scale fast while getting sharper, not softer, with size. What you’ll do - Own the talent function end to end: build and run the hiring engine (sourcing pipelines, interview processes, offer strategy) needed to roughly double headcount over the next year without lowering the bar - Design and implement scalable, data-driven recruiting systems and dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline health, time-to-fill, and quality of hire across every function - Partner directly with the founders and functional leaders to translate headcount plans and growth trajectories into hiring plans, role scorecards, and interview loops that actually predict on-the-job performance - Codify Profound's hiring bar: structured scorecards, calibrated panels, and debrief rituals, so quality holds as the org scales, not just headcount - Own employer brand and top-of-funnel: sharpen how candidates experience Profound before they ever apply, from job descriptions to the careers site to referrals and build Profound's reputation as the place ambitious operators go to do the career-defining work of their lives - Build the recruiting infrastructure for global expansion: optimized ATS for scale, sourcing channels, and compliant interview/offer processes needed to hire as Profound opens new offices and enters new countries, partnering closely with HR/Legal on everything that happens once someone accepts. Lead, coach, and build out a high-leverage talent team as headcount and hiring complexity grow - Stay hands-on, personally sourcing and closing candidates for the roles that matter most (leadership hires, P0 seats) rather than only directing from above Who you are - You've built and scaled a talent function at a high-growth startup before, ideally through a headcount-doubling stretch, and you have the systems and playbooks to prove it - Deeply systems and data oriented; you think about hiring as an engineering problem, including pipelines, funnels, conversion rates, and forecasting, not just relationships - Genuinely energized by high-performance, merit-driven cultures. - Comfortable operating with high agency and ambiguity; you build the plane while flying it - Sharp, fast-moving, and detail-obsessed; nothing about the candidate or employee experience is beneath you - Strong opinions, held loosely; you communicate directly and expect the same from others - Fluent with a modern recruiting and HR stack (ATS, HRIS, sourcing tools); you're comfortable being hands-on, not just strategic - High agency; you identify what needs to happen, scope it, and execute without waiting to be managed Location This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $250,000 to $375,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. Location: Russell Speeders Car Wash (Hamden) 210 Skiff Street, Hamden, CT, USA

In this role, you will review pre-seeded questions paired with images and provide accurate "golden" answers based on what you observe in the image.
